ValidationRule.description: Billing email domain must equal the linked project's contact email domain (VLOOKUP by project Name); lookup ids must be 18 chars when case-safe.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Project_Name_Ref__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Billing_Email__c)), FIND('@', Billing_Email__c) > 0, OR( RIGHT(Billing_Email__c, LEN(Billing_Email__c) - FIND('@', Billing_Email__c)) <> RIGHT(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Contact_Email__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Project_Name_Ref__c), LEN(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Contact_Email__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Project_Name_Ref__c)) - FIND('@', VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Contact_Email__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Project_Name_Ref__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Account__c)), LEN(CASESAFEID(Account__c)) <> 18) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Email domain must match the project's Contact Email domain.
